definitions.explanation: The body's ability to fight off disease, infection, or harmful influences. Also used figuratively for the ability to withstand adverse conditions.

examples.japanese: {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弱|よわ}める→弱める：02331_yowameru⟧。
examples.english: Lack of sleep weakens your immunity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とることで、⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By eating a well-balanced diet, you can boost your resistance to disease.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ (resistance) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Most commonly used in health and medical contexts to refer to the body's natural defense mechanisms against illness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to boost resistance/immunity
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: resistance drops
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: to have weak resistance
- {抵抗力|ていこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to build up resistance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{免疫力|めんえきりょく}→免疫力：08599_menekiryoku⟧: immune strength — more specifically about the immune system
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧: physical strength, stamina — broader, covering overall physical fitness
- ⟦{耐性|たいせい}→耐性：13917_taisei⟧: tolerance, resistance — used for drug resistance or acquired tolerance
